title: NAT and PAT: Address Translation

steps.objective: Enter privileged mode to explore NAT concepts
steps.teachingPoint: NAT translates private IPs to public IPs for Internet access
NAT config includes 'ip nat inside/outside' on interfaces

legacyCommands: ! Step 1: Create ACL to identify inside hosts
! Step 3: Enable PAT (overload) using WAN interface IP
! ip nat inside source list 1 interface g0/0 overload
! The server should be reachable from outside as WAN_SUBNET.100
! Example: If WAN is 10.0.0.0/24, server appears as 10.0.0.100
! - All LAN hosts share one public IP (WAN interface)
! - Static NAT maps one private IP to one public IP
! - Static NAT public IP should match WAN subnet (x.x.x.100)
